# opnsense_quagga_ospf6_routemap (Resource)

Manages one OPNsense OSPFv3 route-map entry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the route map.
- `route_map_id` (Number) Route-map sequence ID (10-99).

### Optional

- `action` (String) Whether this route-map entry permits or denies matching routes. Defaults to `permit`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable this route-map entry. Defaults to `true`.
- `prefix_lists` (Set of String) UUIDs of prefix-list entries matched by this route-map entry. Defaults to `[]`.
- `set` (String) Optional FRR route-map set expression. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the route-map entry.
